contexts.text: Like birds taught to sing the tune of a holy hymn.
On the harmonious hymns of the Angels.
I heard Angels of the interior Heaven... forming a hymn...
The Angels clearly perceived those hymns...
By their hymns they formed a golden crown with diamonds round the head of our Saviour...
These hymns, which two infantile choirs were forming, could not be disturbed by phantasies...
I again heard those hymning or singing the praise of our Saviour; in fact some choirs together...
